?# AMES Food Advisory

> Food safety consulting, HACCP planning, training, and auditing for NSW food businesses — based in Sydney, Australia.

AMES Food Advisory is a food safety consultancy serving food businesses across Sydney and NSW. Services include Food Safety Program (FSP) development, HACCP plans, Food Safety Supervisor (FSS) training, internal auditing, and start-up compliance packages.

## Services

- [HACCP & Food Safety Consulting](/food-safety-consulting-sydney): Food Safety Program writing, hazard analysis, HACCP plan development, regulatory compliance gap analysis.
- [Food Safety Training](/food-safety-training-sydney): NSW Food Authority approved Food Safety Supervisor courses, food handler training, team workshops.
- [Internal Auditing](/internal-auditing-services): pre-audit inspections, supplier readiness audits, third-party certification preparation.
- [Food Business Start-Up Package](/food-business-startup-package): End-to-end compliance setup for new food businesses — council notification, FSP, HACCP, SOP suite, training.
- [Suburb Directory](/suburb-directory): Service coverage across Sydney metro and surrounds.

## Free Resources

- [Free Resources Hub](/free-resources): Overview of all free tools.
- [NSW Compliance Checklist](/free-compliance-checklist-nsw): 47-point interactive checklist for NSW food businesses.
- [Restaurant SOP Template](/free-restaurant-sop-template): 7-SOP template covering receiving, temperature, cooking, cooling, allergens, cleaning, personal hygiene.
- [Audit Readiness Checklist](/free-audit-readiness-checklist): Pre-audit self-assessment with 21-day preparation timeline.

## About

George Skarmoutsos — 11+ years in food manufacturing (Arnott's), TAFE NSW accredited trainer, dual-accredited food safety consultant. Sydney, NSW, Australia.

Contact: george@amesfoodadvisory.com.au
